# agent-qa

> Record a user scenario in a real browser. Replay it later. See exactly what changed.

agent-qa is a CLI (plus browser extension) that captures browser sessions as deterministic replay scripts — `scenario.json` — with visual goldens, network/console claims, self-heal, and a PR-level golden loop. No model calls on replay.

## Docs (markdown mirrors — same URL as the HTML page, minus the trailing slash)

- [Quickstart](https://rasmusjosefsson.github.io/agent-qa/docs/quickstart.md): install, record, replay in five minutes
- [How it works](https://rasmusjosefsson.github.io/agent-qa/docs/overview.md): the whole system in one read
- [Configuration](https://rasmusjosefsson.github.io/agent-qa/docs/configuration.md): agent-qa.toml, env vars, precedence
- [CLI verbs](https://rasmusjosefsson.github.io/agent-qa/docs/verbs.md): complete verb reference
- [Golden screenshots](https://rasmusjosefsson.github.io/agent-qa/docs/visual-testing.md): shot claims, baselines, re-mint loop
- [Network claims](https://rasmusjosefsson.github.io/agent-qa/docs/network.md): network and console claims behind the UI
- [Templates](https://rasmusjosefsson.github.io/agent-qa/docs/templates.md): reusable sub-scenarios via useTemplate
- [Plugins](https://rasmusjosefsson.github.io/agent-qa/docs/plugins.md): JSON-over-stdio plugin contract
- [Browser extension](https://rasmusjosefsson.github.io/agent-qa/docs/extension.md): one-click capture → ingest → replay
- [GitHub Action](https://rasmusjosefsson.github.io/agent-qa/docs/github-action.md): replay scenarios on every PR
- [Lint rules](https://rasmusjosefsson.github.io/agent-qa/docs/lint-rules.md): scenario lint catalogue
- [Architecture](https://rasmusjosefsson.github.io/agent-qa/docs/architecture.md): codemap and runtime flows
- [Session hygiene](https://rasmusjosefsson.github.io/agent-qa/docs/process-hygiene.md): ps + cleanup for stray daemons
- [Releasing](https://rasmusjosefsson.github.io/agent-qa/docs/releasing.md): cross-compile, package, publish

## Capabilities

- [Agent manifest](https://rasmusjosefsson.github.io/agent-qa/.well-known/agent.json): machine-readable capability list
- [Repository](https://github.com/rasmusjosefsson/agent-qa): source, issues, releases
- `agent-qa mcp` serves the CLI as MCP tools over stdio — record, replay, lint, audit from an MCP client
